description: This file implements the SmsService class, which handles various SMS-related AT commands in a modem simulator environment. It manages sending, receiving, storing, and deleting SMS messages, as well as configuring broadcast and service center settings.

classes.name: SmsService
classes.description: A class that simulates SMS service functionalities, including handling AT commands for SMS operations.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes the list of command handlers for SMS-related AT commands.

methods.name: InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Sets the initial state variables for the SMS service.

methods.name: SetupDependency
methods.description: Sets the dependency on a SimService instance.

methods.name: HandleSendSMS
methods.description: Handles the AT+CMGS command to send an SMS message.

methods.name: HandleSMSAcknowledge
methods.description: Handles the AT+CNMA command to acknowledge receipt of an SMS.

methods.name: HandleWriteSMSToSim
methods.description: Handles the AT+CMGW command to store an SMS to the SIM.

methods.name: HandleDeleteSmsOnSim
methods.description: Handles the AT+CMGD command to delete an SMS from the SIM.

methods.name: HandleBroadcastConfig
methods.description: Handles the AT+CSCB command to configure broadcast SMS settings.

methods.name: HandleGetSmscAddress
methods.description: Handles the AT+CSCA? command to get the SMSC address.

methods.name: HandleSetSmscAddress
methods.description: Handles the AT+CSCA= command to set the SMSC address.

methods.name: SendSmsToRemote
methods.description: Sends an SMS PDU to a remote port via a connected remote client.

methods.name: HandleSendSMSPDU
methods.description: Processes the AT+CMGS PDU command to send an SMS in PDU mode.

methods.name: HandleReceiveSMS
methods.description: Handles incoming SMS PDUs and triggers unsolicited notifications.

methods.name: HandleWriteSMSPduToSim
methods.description: Stores an SMS PDU to the SIM and responds with the index.

methods.name: HandleSMSStatuReport
methods.description: Generates and sends an SMS status report.
